profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer specializing in web, JavaScript, React and A/B testing.
Former WordPress Theme & Plugin Developer.
https://github.com/jqlee85

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on web platform and performance improvements on Asana's Growth Platform team. Improving performance monitoring and bundle optimizations for a high-traffic NextJS application. Maintaining web A/B testing framework.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served as tech-lead for Web Engineering Growth team
Drove direction for experimentation and frontend signup on Asana's public-facing website
Architected/developed frontend A/B testing framework with ReactJS
Scaled web experimentation program

positions.title: Web Engineer
positions.description:
Served as technical lead for the Web Engineering Growth team, focusing on A/B testing and signup/login
Developed and tested features for the highest-traffic pages on Asana.com
Architected/developed a ReactJS A/B testing framework
Developed a homepage redesign which was nominated for a 2021 Webby Award

positions.title: Senior JavaScript Engineer: React
positions.description:
Built and maintained ReactJS apps using Node and GatsbyJS, and headless CMS backends using REST/GraphQL APIs
Developed features for Google's open-source WordPress plugin (Site Kit) in partnership with Google's engineers
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · WordPress · GatsbyJS · React.js · Node.js

positions.title: Full Stack Javascript Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and built realtime dashboards using ReactJS and Google Cloud Platform.
Used Cloud Functions and Firestore to process data coming from multiple data sources (hardware, machine learning pipelines), and serve data to the frontend. 
Collaborated with product managers, hardware teams, and developers to collect, process, and deliver data to clients.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Node.js

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed web apps with React, Redux, GraphQL, Firebase and Google Cloud Platform, WordPress, Node, and REST APIs.
Developed responsive, premium WordPress Themes and Plugins for Organic Themes.
Designed and developed themes and features for GivingPress, a managed WordPress hosting solution.
Built backend plugins connecting WooCommerce purchases to backend hosting services via a REST API.
Customized and supported WordPress themes for the WordPress.com Premium repository.
Responded to feature requests and bug reports, deployed updates to existing products being used by hundreds of thousands of users.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · PHP · HTML · jQuery · WordPress · React.js · Node.js

positions.title: Web Developer (PHP & JS)
positions.description:
Developed responsive, premium WordPress Themes and Plugins for Organic Themes, using PHP, JS, HTML & CSS.
Customized and supported WordPress themes for the WordPress.com Premium repository.
Responded to feature requests and bug reports and pushed updates to existing products being used by hundreds of thousands of users.

positions.title: Web Designer & Developer
positions.description:
Designed/coded and assembled responsive sites using HTML/CSS/JS/PHP and WordPress.
Created compelling infographics for high-traffic sites reaching millions a year.
Built, customized and maintained e-commerce sites.
Developed custom WordPress Plugins and Themes as needed.

positions.title: Image Manager
positions.description:
Managed a team of 15 designers/photographers.
Edited photos and responded to service requests.
Designed/coded/implemented internal automation/productivity tools and dashboards using HTML/CSS/JS/PHP.
Tracked image quality and update requests, generating performance metrics from Zendesk data.
